description: This source file defines the static class LogFormatter, which provides utility methods for formatting date, time, and exception information for logging purposes within the Orleans runtime. It includes constants for log message size limits and date/time formats, methods for printing and parsing dates, and for printing exceptions with detailed inner exception information. It also supports configuring custom exception decoders.

classes.name: LogFormatter
classes.description: A static utility class for formatting various values such as dates and exceptions for logging purposes within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: PrintDate
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object into a string formatted according to the specified date pattern, used for logging.

methods.name: ParseDate
methods.description: Parses a string into a DateTime object based on the specified date format.

methods.name: PrintTime
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object into a string formatted according to the specified time pattern, used for logging.

methods.name: PrintException
methods.description: Converts an exception, including nested inner exceptions, into a detailed string for logging.

methods.name: SetExceptionDecoder
methods.description: Allows registration of custom decoders for specific exception types, influencing how exceptions are converted to strings.
